content:
We are excited to announce that the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI) at NeurIPS 2026 is now open for submissions!

MATH-AI brings together researchers working at the intersection of AI and mathematics, with a particular focus this year on how agentic AI systems can advance mathematical research while remaining reliable collaborators for human mathematicians.

The workshop will explore topics including:

  • Formalization and theorem proving: autoformalization, proof generation, proof verification, and interactive theorem proving
  • Reliable mathematical agents: AI systems that can plan, use tools, generate conjectures, formalize, prove, verify, and learn from feedback
  • Mathematical reasoning and evaluation: benchmarks and evaluation methods for correctness, robustness, proof quality, and mathematical capabilities
  • Automated mathematical research and discovery
  • Human-AI collaboration in mathematics
  • Applications of mathematical reasoning in science, engineering, verification, and beyond

:calendar: Workshop: NeurIPS 2026 | Atlanta, Georgia
:calendar: Date: December 12 or 13, 2026 (exact date TBD)

:www: Workshop Website: https://mathai-2026.github.io/

:inbox: Submission via OpenReview: https://openreview.net/group?id=NeurIPS.cc/2026/Workshop/MATH-AI

Key Dates

Event Date
Paper Submission Deadline September 25, 2026 (AoE)
Author Notification October 19, 2026 (AoE)
Camera-ready Deadline October 29, 2026 (AoE)

Submission Details

  • Format: 4-page NeurIPS workshop format (references and supplementary materials unlimited)
  • Review: Double-blind review via OpenReview
  • Archival: Non-archival
  • Awards: Best Paper Award and Honorable Mentions

We welcome submissions from researchers across formal methods, theorem proving, mathematical reasoning, AI agents, machine learning, programming languages, and related areas.

We are also recruiting reviewers for the workshop. If you are interested in reviewing submissions related to mathematical reasoning, formalization, theorem proving, or AI for mathematics, please sign up here:

:search: Reviewer Nomination Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSenuh8uLvudlAA0ifF-pGU\_XjpgU7CINQBFeDC0Acq\_tIq2YQ/viewform?usp=header

Finally, we have set up a Discord channel as a convenient place to stay up to date with future MATH-AI workshop announcements, submission updates, and related information:

:umm: Discord: https://discord.gg/A8GfNhhCT

Looking forward to your submissions and to seeing the formal mathematics and AI communities come together at NeurIPS 2026!
